description: Committee to direct review of City Council Advisory Committees.
Review examines mandates, relevance, and improvement opportunities.
It will also assess co-sponsorship and funding processes.

chips.text: City Council Advisory Committees will be reviewed and engaged.

description: Advisory Committees must submit 2027 work plans and budget requests.
New process links committee work plans to budgets.
Submissions are due by October 1 annually for Council review.
Committee to review Wild About Saskatoon's May 31, 2026 event report.
Saskatoon's 2025 expenditure statement is provided for information.
